Maria (mktg-ops): Heads up — HubSpot -> Salesforce mapping broke for inbound form leads. ~2h of unassigned leads, SLA alerts firing. Anyone available?
Sam R (revops): On it. Can you paste an example lead id / payload?
Maria (mktg-ops): Example: hs_lead_id=00345abc; hubspot_owner_id present, but salesforce OwnerId=null. Form=pricing
Jess T (sales): Sales seeing ~14 leads in "Unassigned" queue. SDRs are getting notified manually :grimacing:
Aaron L (sales-ops): I think the workflow change from this morning removed the 'assign owner' branch. Rolling back now.
Priya (growth): If rollback takes >10m can we set a temporary default owner in HS? e.g., assign to marketing-ops queue so SLAs don't keep escalating.
Sam R (revops): +1. Also add a safeguard webhook to SF that enforces owner on create. Quick patch:
```hubspot-workflow
Trigger: contact.form_submitted == true AND contact.owner == NULL
Action: Set contact.owner = "Aaron L (temp)"
Delay: 0m
ExpireAfter: 24h
```
Maria (mktg-ops): I created that temp workflow and set owner=Aaron L. Also patched HubSpot sync rule to retry orphaned leads.
hubspot-sync-bot: Salesforce sync resumed for batch 178246: 14 records processed, 0 errors.
Jess T (sales): Seeing owners populate now. Thanks!
Aaron L (sales-ops): Rollback done. Reverted the accidental workflow change. Will validate assignment rules in SF:
```salesforce-assignment-rule
if Lead.Source == "pricing" and OwnerId == NULL -> Assign to Queue: SDR-Pricing
```
Sam R (revops): I'll add a unit test to the automation that prevents deploying a workflow that removes owner assignment. Also adding alert if unassigned leads > 5 for 30m.
Priya (growth): Can we add a runbook to marketing playbook? Quick steps + who to ping.
Maria (mktg-ops): Added note to /docs/marketing-oncall -> "Inbound SLA: assignment checks". cc @Aaron L for review.
Aaron L (sales-ops): Monitoring now. If counts spike I'll open a follow-up thread. All good for now :thumbsup:
